benchmark: PCOE Authority Epoch Transition and Durable Revocation Qualification

scenarios.threat: Both authority sets sign the exact same transition digest
scenarios.preconditions: Old and new witness sets are authenticated; checkpoint is complete; both sets retain quorum.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Collect one old-set quorum and one new-set quorum over the identical transition digest.
scenarios.required_control: Require both independently evaluated membership quorums over the same digest and checkpoint.

scenarios.threat: Old set reaches quorum while the new set is unavailable
scenarios.preconditions: The old set has quorum; the new set has fewer than its threshold during a partition.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to certify the transition using only the old-set quorum.
scenarios.required_control: A joint transition certificate is not issued; the old set remains frozen for new admissions once preparation begins.

scenarios.threat: New set reaches quorum while the old set is unavailable
scenarios.preconditions: The new set has quorum; the old set has fewer than its threshold.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to activate the new epoch using only the new-set quorum.
scenarios.required_control: No unilateral new-set activation; do not silently lower either threshold.

scenarios.threat: Old and new signers attest different transition payloads
scenarios.preconditions: A transition identity is already bound to one immutable digest.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Present a second payload under the same transition identity or mix signatures for different digests.
scenarios.required_control: Every signer and certificate must bind one canonical digest; mixed-digest evidence is rejected or held.

scenarios.threat: One logical witness belongs to both old and new sets
scenarios.preconditions: The signer is a member of both sets and signs the joint transition digest once.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to count an alias or repeated signature as multiple identities within either set.
scenarios.required_control: One authenticated logical identity is counted at most once per membership set; a shared member may satisfy membership in each set without being duplicated inside a set.

scenarios.threat: One logical witness presents old and new key aliases
scenarios.preconditions: Two key identifiers resolve to one enrolled logical witness identity.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Present both key aliases as independent quorum members.
scenarios.required_control: Resolve keys to one stable logical identity before counting; alias enrollment cannot increase quorum cardinality.

scenarios.threat: Removed old signer attempts a new admission after activation
scenarios.preconditions: The new epoch is active and the old epoch barrier is committed.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Replay a stale old-epoch certificate as authority for a newly created effect.
scenarios.required_control: Historical old certificates remain evidence for historical effects only; they cannot authorize new effects after the barrier.

scenarios.threat: New signer attempts admission before joint activation
scenarios.preconditions: The transition is prepared or incomplete; the new epoch is not active.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit a new-epoch effect before activation.
scenarios.required_control: No new-epoch effect becomes spendable before a joint transition certificate and activation.

scenarios.preconditions: An initial digest has been prepared and signer evidence may already exist.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Rewrite the proposal digest while keeping the transition identity and existing signer evidence.
scenarios.required_control: The prepared digest is immutable; a changed payload requires a new, explicitly authorized transition identity.

scenarios.preconditions: A witness has persisted its non-equivocation journal before acknowledging its signature.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Restart the witness and ask it to sign a conflicting digest.
scenarios.required_control: The durable journal survives restart and refuses a second digest for the same transition identity.

scenarios.threat: Witness restores a snapshot preceding an issued vote
scenarios.preconditions: An already-issued signature remains externally observable; the restored snapshot lacks that vote.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Restore the old snapshot and request a conflicting signature.
scenarios.required_control: Recovery must prove journal monotonicity from a trusted checkpoint; unproven rollback disables signing.

scenarios.threat: A signing key is revoked before joint certification
scenarios.preconditions: A revocation record has a qualified effective checkpoint and scope.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit a certificate whose required signature depends on the revoked key.
scenarios.required_control: Apply revocation according to explicit effective-checkpoint semantics; do not count revoked authority for later admissions.

scenarios.threat: A key is reported compromised after a certificate
scenarios.preconditions: A previously valid certificate exists; compromise timing and scope require adjudication.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to retroactively erase or silently grandfather all prior certificates.
scenarios.required_control: Preserve historical evidence and apply the declared compromise-window policy; do not rewrite past effects by default.

scenarios.threat: Network partition prevents one side reaching quorum
scenarios.preconditions: Joint preparation has begun; only one membership set can form quorum.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Retry, timeout, or lower a threshold to force progress.
scenarios.required_control: Safety thresholds remain fixed; liveness may pause until both sides and checkpoint evidence are available.

scenarios.threat: Same transition request is submitted concurrently many times
scenarios.preconditions: Identical transition identity, digest, old/new set digests and checkpoint are presented.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit 100 identical requests concurrently and replay them after response loss.
scenarios.required_control: Exactly one logical transition record is retained; retries resolve its original certificate and do not increment the epoch twice.

scenarios.threat: Conflicting payloads race under one transition identity
scenarios.preconditions: One transition identity is concurrently presented with 100 distinct transition digests.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Race all payloads and attempt first-writer ambiguity or last-write-wins.
scenarios.required_control: One digest may bind; every conflicting payload is held/rejected with no second active epoch.
